name: Tin El Investigador
tagline: Turns a question into a ready-to-post Spanish update every day
description: Works a subject across the web and the tools you have connected, then returns each day with a draft in Spanish, ready for X. Every draft braids three strands: a short reflection, one entertainment story and one useful fact, so the post has a shape rather than a dump of links.
author: valengiulimor
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
